system.description:
Self; 1 minute per level. Take the form of any animal or monster of Level up to your level, changing form once per round (no action). You take each form's whole stat block and keep your mind, and cannot cast or use your gear. When you change from one form to another, the new form starts with the HP the old form had left, never more than its own maximum. When a form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form (see Changing Shape). Material: a jade circlet worth 1,500 gp (not consumed).

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Druid, Sorcerer
